title: Prime Minister shares an article highlighting India’s journey towards Viksit Bharat 2047 shaped by sustained reforms and investment
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, today shared an article by Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) President Shri R Mukundan, highlighting how India's journey towards Viksit Bharat 2047 is being shaped by sustained reforms and investment across key sectors. Shri Mukundan highlighted the foundations laid through infrastructure investment, GST, digital public infrastructure, corporate tax reforms, PLI schemes, and trade agreements, emphasizing the importance of government and industry working together as Team Bharat to turn India's economic potential into lasting prosperity. The Prime Minister's Office posted on X: “India's journey towards Viksit Bharat 2047 is being shaped by sustained reforms and investment across key sectors. @FollowCII President R Mukundan writes about the foundations laid through infrastructure investment, GST, digital public infrastructure, corporate tax reforms, PLI schemes and trade agreements. He highlights the importance of government and industry working together as Team Bharat to turn India's economic potential into lasting prosperity. https://www.business-standard.com/opinion/columns/the-article-a-cii-president-will-write-in-2047-a-roadmap-for-industry-126112401097_1.html ” India's journey towards Viksit Bharat 2047 is being shaped by sustained reforms and investment across key sectors.

@FollowCII President R Mukundan writes about the foundations laid through infrastructure investment, GST, digital public infrastructure, corporate tax reforms, PLI schemes and trade agreements.

He highlights the importance of government and industry working together as Team Bharat to turn India's economic potential into lasting prosperity.
